description: This header file defines utility functions and classes for security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a specific project. It includes functions for retrieving security tokens, checking Thunder security configuration, and managing plugin states.

classes.name: SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving and managing security tokens, including checking Thunder security configuration.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class that executes a provided function, with conditional inheritance based on the USE_THUNDER_R4 macro.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves the security token, caching it for subsequent calls, and checks if Thunder security is configured.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: A callback function to handle curl responses, appending data to a string stream.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to check if Thunder security subsystem is enabled by inspecting the response JSON.

methods.name: getThunderControllerClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a Thunder controller client with an authentication token.

methods.name: getServiceState
methods.description: Queries the state of a plugin service by its callsign.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a plugin identified by its callsign asynchronously.
